name: session-notes
description: Record the current coding session as one dev note, through the notes MCP client shipped with the plugin.

NOTES_URL.title: Notes MCP URL
NOTES_URL.description: Full URL of the notes server, for example https://example.com/api/notes/mcp

NOTES_TOKEN.title: Notes API token
NOTES_TOKEN.description: Bearer token (omk_...) with full access, created in the site back-office
